scope: Isolated candidate diagnostics; no production switch. Contains counts and route metadata only.

historicalSuccessfulChild.responseModelNote: The persisted replay metadata contains no responseModel field; absence does not identify the upstream backend.

candidate16384Probe.continuationNote: No owned image or committed source existed; the bounded continuation rule correctly refused a new child.

assetOnlyProbe.purpose: Determine whether the current mapped route can emit an asset tool call with a short task and forced named tool. Returned tool is never executed.
assetOnlyProbe.limitation: Both task length and tool choice changed, so this probe does not isolate their effects. It proves tool-call capability, not completed image/code generation.

fullPromptForcedAssetProbe.purpose: Replay only the recorded input messages and three tool schemas from the 16384 failure, with the baseline 8192 cap and a named first-asset tool choice. No assistant reasoning or output is replayed. Returned tool is never executed.
fullPromptForcedAssetProbe.limitation: This single probe supports named first-tool choice on the unchanged task. It does not prove subsequent code generation or image execution succeeds.

interpretation: The 16384 cap was active; the failure is not explained by an unchanged 8192 parent cap.
The latest task is about half the character length of the historical successful task, with the identical system-message character length.
The configured upstream model remains deepseek-v4.1-flash; hy4-free is an upstream-reported response model, not a configured local alias.
The latest failure occurred before any asset or code tool call, so source validation and image usage checks did not cause that failure.

firstAssetActualCandidate.interpretation: Named first-asset choice succeeds, but ordinary tool choice still spends the entire output budget before any source write. The single continuation correctly reuses the image and terminates after its second child.

resumeForcedWriterProbe.purpose: Replay recorded resume input messages and two tool schemas, changing only ordinary tool choice to the named writer. No assistant reasoning or output is replayed; no returned tool is executed.
resumeForcedWriterProbe.interpretation: Named first-writer choice alone does not resolve code-phase planning exhaustion on the current mapped route. This diagnostic does not support extending the proxy to force the writer.

focusedFirstWriterProbe.purpose: Test a focused first source chunk with the actual owned image path, only the incline/body/vector data contract, and no prior private reasoning or full visual brief.
focusedFirstWriterProbe.limitation: Only tool-argument length was counted, and the tool was not executed. Argument JSON validity, actual content length against the 2400-character limit, syntax, drawing guard compatibility, and rendered output are unverified. The 3274-character serialized arguments may contain an oversized code chunk.
focusedFirstWriterProbe.interpretation: A focused first-chunk task elicits a writer tool call where the full task did not. It still consumes the entire 8192-token output allowance with 7013 reported reasoning tokens, so this is partial feasibility evidence, not a reliable completed-generation result.

compactAuthorActualCandidate.limitation: Actual generation failed before the first asset call. The proxy predicate matches the logged initial three-tool schema, but this record alone does not capture the final outgoing tool_choice.
